description: Its 'good' verdict is provisional until the Elixir side is as fast as we can make it. Ideas: Walk packed binaries with binary matching instead of a tuple list; coarse grid / bounding-box prefilter applied to BOTH sides (it is an algorithmic trick, not a defk feature). Record alternatives tried; set baseline: :optimized. If Elixir comes within 2x, the verdict becomes marginal and Elixir is the recommendation: record that as a result.

title: Optimise the Elixir baseline: geo_nearest
